_design: Core Keeper wilderness principle: dense inside, carved clearings between. Minecraft forest: tree walls you can't see through. Gary's forest uses plains2 floor + heavy canopy. Grove is the primary identity-giver. Increased groveCentersPer100 (1.8 vs 1.3), tightened falloff (0.12 vs 0.15), high fillDensity (0.60). Ferns added as understory. Dead tree rare variant for narrative depth.

subfeatures._: Understory props placed inside cluster radius after tree occupancy resolved

placement._: Spacing of 7 at radius 5 means 2-4 cell clearings between grove walls.
